Edge Cases for the Converter

This page exercises situations that real sites produce and that previously broke the converter or the page it ran on. It has enough text for Readability to treat it as an article rather than a fragment of navigation or boilerplate.

The page defines a fake AMD loader. The converter must not register JSZip with it, and must leave both the loader function and its amd flag in place afterwards, so the site's own modules keep working.

The image before this sentence comes from a server that never answers. The converter must give up on it after a timeout and still produce the book.

The image before this sentence is lazy-loaded: a placeholder GIF with the real, relative URL in data-src. It must resolve against the page's base URL, which points one directory up.

Formulas and drawings

The mean is x=m for a sample, and the variance is v\sigma^2 in this sentence, which keeps going so it reads as prose.

A copy hidden for accessibility tools hshould not be duplicated, and neither should a decorative icon placed next to text.

A labelled chart: is replaced by its label, since inline drawings are not embedded yet.
